lines.text: Zophar the Naamathite says the triumph of the wicked has been brief since man was placed on the earth.
Though the wicked man's head touches the clouds, he will fly away like a dream and never be found.
His sons will seek the favor of the king, and his food will sour into the venom of cobras.
He has oppressed and forsaken the poor, so God will vent His fury upon him as he eats.
Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped spear pierces him and terrors come over him.
